The '''Rain Totem''' is a [[Crafting#Consumables|crafted item]] that sets the [[weather]] for the next day to rain. A Rain Totem can be activated by selecting it in inventory and pressing the [[Controls|''Check'' button]] ([[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] on PC, '''Y''' on Nintendo Switch, '''A''' on Xbox, '''X''' on PlayStation). 

The crafting recipe becomes available at [[Foraging]] Level 9. One to three Rain Totems may also occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern.

==Caveats==
*The weather in [[Pelican Town]] and [[Ginger Island]] can be different, and the weather will only be changed in the region where the Rain Totem is activated.
*A Rain Totem will not force the weather in Pelican Town to be rainy on [[Festivals|festival]] days or on the 1st day of a season.

==Bundles==
Rain Totem is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
A Rain Totem can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Totem Mask|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Rain Totem is not used in any [[quests]].

==Bugs==
*If a Rain Totem is used during [[Winter]] on the day before a snowy day, it will cause it to rain and snow simultaneously the following day.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
{{History|1.6|Fixed a bug where using a Rain Totem on a stormy day would turn the next day's [[weather]] to stormy instead of rainy; storms could be chained in this way to obtain large numbers of [[Battery Pack]]s.}}
